prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on what you need (platform, budget, creative control, whether you want AI presenters, personalization at scale, etc.). Below are top picks by common use case plus quick pros/cons to help you choose.

If you want one recommendation now
- If you need realistic, professional-looking presenter videos (explainer ads, B2B, multi‑language): Synthesia or HeyGen.
- If you want quick, templated social ads from text/URLs: InVideo, Promo.com, or Biteable.
- If you’re repurposing long videos into short ad clips: Pictory.
- If you want advanced generative edits, creative effects, or experimental text-to-video: Runway.
- If you want a robust all‑round editor with AI transcription/overdub: Descript.

Top tools by category
- Synthesia / HeyGen
  - Best for: AI presenters, multilingual voiceover, brand-safe corporate ads.
  - Strengths: Realistic avatars, script-to-video, easy localization.
  - Consider if you need spokesperson-style ads.

- InVideo / Promo.com / Biteable
  - Best for: Fast social ads, lots of templates and stock clips, beginners.
  - Strengths: Template libraries, quick resizing for platforms, low learning curve.

- Pictory
  - Best for: Turning blog posts, webinars, long videos into short ad clips.
  - Strengths: Auto-highlights, captioning, quick repurposing.

- Runway
  - Best for: Creative, experimental ads — generative edits, background replacement, advanced effects.
  - Strengths: Powerful generative tools, good for agencies or creative teams.

- Descript
  - Best for: Editors who want transcription-based editing, overdub voice cloning.
  - Strengths: Precise editorial control and audio workflows.

- FlexClip / VEED.io
  - Best for: Simple edits plus some AI features (subtitles, auto-crops).
  - Strengths: Affordable, easy to use, good for small teams.

- Enterprise / personalization at scale
  - Look at DCO and ad-optimization platforms (examples: Jivox, specialized offerings from ad platforms/agencies)
  - Best for: Large-scale personalized dynamic creative tied to ad platforms and data feeds.

How to choose
- Platform: TikTok/Reels need vertical, punchy, fast edits — favor template-focused tools.
- Creative style: Want an on-screen human? Use Synthesia/HeyGen. Want stock-driven product ads? Promo/InVideo.
- Scale & localization: If you’ll produce many language versions, pick a tool with multilingual voices and easy script swapping.
- Budget & speed: Template tools are cheapest and fastest; enterprise/personalization solutions cost more.

Want a tailored pick?
Tell me: target platform (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), ad length, style (presenter, product shots, UGC-style), and rough budget — I’ll recommend two best options and a simple workflow.
